self.view.custom.roleOverride = "maintenance"

props.text: Evaluated on the gateway, not in the page.

config.script:
from java.lang import Throwable
	self.view.custom.seek = False
	self.view.custom.jog = -1
	try:
		system.tag.writeBlocking(["[MachineDemo]Robot/JogDown"], [True])
	except Throwable:
		pass

from java.lang import Throwable
	self.view.custom.seek = False
	self.view.custom.jog = 1
	try:
		system.tag.writeBlocking(["[MachineDemo]Robot/JogUp"], [True])
	except Throwable:
		pass

props.text: Hold a jog button to move. Release it, or slide off it, and the momentary bit drops and motion stops.

config.script:
self.view.custom.seek = True
	self.view.custom.jog = 0
	self.view.custom.liftTarget = 0.0
	from java.lang import Throwable
	try:
		system.tag.writeBlocking(["[MachineDemo]Robot/Homed"], [True])
	except Throwable:
		pass

self.view.custom.seek = True
	self.view.custom.jog = 0
	self.view.custom.liftTarget = 900.0

from java.lang import Throwable
	try:
		cur = float(system.tag.readBlocking(["[MachineDemo]Robot/Lift_mm"])[0].value)
		self.view.custom.liftTarget = cur
	except Throwable:
		pass
	self.view.custom.jog = 0
	self.view.custom.seek = False

config.expression: (coalesce({[MachineDemo]Safety/EStopOK}, false)) && (coalesce({[MachineDemo]Safety/GuardsClosed}, false)) && (coalesce({[MachineDemo]Safety/AirPressureOK}, false)) && (coalesce({[MachineDemo]Safety/InterfacesOK}, false)) && (coalesce({[MachineDemo]Robot/MotorsOn}, false)) && (coalesce({[MachineDemo]Robot/Homed}, false)) && (coalesce({[MachineDemo]Robot/Healthy}, false)) && (!coalesce({[MachineDemo]Robot/Fault}, false)) && (coalesce({[MachineDemo]Line/Mode}, "Auto") = "Manual")
